<!-- overview:start -->

## Overview

Goal: Validate consumer catalogs and their public issue-form projection.
Behavior: Check catalogs and form choices without writing files or opening a PR.
Report invalid catalogs and form drift as diagnostics; technical failures fail CI.
Logs and summaries contain concise codes, fields and affected files.

### Permissions

- **`contents`**: `read`

<!-- overview:end -->
<!-- usage:start -->

## Usage

```yaml
name: Referential / Check catalog and form
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
permissions: {}
jobs:
  referential-check-catalog-and-form:
    uses: cloud-native-aixmarseille/meetup-event-automation/.github/workflows/referential-check-catalog-and-form.yml@5a80cd5013781ff071bea0dfda49044bc4071c5f # 2.3.2
    permissions:
      contents: read
    with:
      # Language for generated reports and guidance (en or fr). Regional variants are supported; unsupported locales fall back to English.
      # This input is required.
      locale: ""
```

<!-- usage:end -->
